entries.text: You all set to tutor the other Team Star bosses\nup to test-bossin’ level?[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_aku_01

entries.text: Hey, don’t sweat it—we’re not goin’ anywhere.\nCome on back whenever you’re ready.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_aku_02

entries.text: Music to my ears! Let’s go lay down a killer\nstudy sesh![VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_aku_03

entries.text: Are you free right now to help us with some\ntutoring, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_kakutou_01

entries.text: No problem! We’re fine hanging out here for as\nlong as it takes![VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_kakutou_02

entries.text: Fantastic! Come on, then—we’ll show you to the\nclassroom.[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_kakutou_03

entries.text: ’Sup, gang! Studying hard, I hope?[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_aku_04

entries.text: Well, we WERE before you and your big mouth\nshowed up!\c\nHere to check we’re not slacking off, are you?[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_fairy_01

entries.text: Pretty much. Your eyes start glazing over the\nsecond I’m out the door. Tell me I’m wrong.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_aku_05

entries.text: Ah, Lady Eri clad in her academy uniform...[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_doku_01

entries.text: I feel mine eyes sharpen and my mind focus\neach time this vision returns to greet me.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_doku_02

entries.text: If only that focus were helpful for your studies,\nAtticus... Sorry I keep distracting you.[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_kakutou_04

entries.text: Oho? What’s this?! My ninja senses detect the\npresence of another behind thee, Lady Eri![VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_doku_03

entries.text: Come!!! Step forward, knave, that we might see\nthy face![VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_doku_04

entries.text: It’s your tutor!
entries.label: s2_sub_008_select_02

entries.text: YOU?! What the—? Noooooo no no no, why is\nthis happening?![VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_fairy_02

entries.text: Ah. I should have surmis’d as much. The strength\nof thy spirit precedes thee as ever, good [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0406)]fellowlady.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_doku_05

entries.text: Never mind that! Giacomo! EXPLAIN! What’s\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)] doing here?![VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_fairy_03

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Hey now, be nice! [VAR 0x0100(0000)]...
Wait,
no,
Professor
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]
is
gonna
be
your tutor![VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_aku_06

entries.text: O, glad tidings! I am truly grateful to hear it.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_doku_06

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0201)]HShe’s gonna be WHAT?! Since when?![VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_fairy_04

entries.text: You can’t just go stomping around deciding stuff\nlike this without asking anyone, Giacomo![VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_fairy_05

entries.text: And YOU! We don’t need a tutor! Do us a favor\nand toddle on home, would you?[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_fairy_06

entries.text: ...Hey, Ortie?[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_kakutou_05

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0100(0000)] kindly agreed to
come
here
and
help
us out.[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_kakutou_06

entries.text: So talking to h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]imer with that kind of attitude...[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_kakutou_07

entries.text: I S   U N A C C E P T A B L E . . . R I G H T ?[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_kakutou_08

entries.text: Gah... Y-yeah, no, totally, I... Sorry, Eri.[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_fairy_07

entries.text: S O R R Y ,   * W H O * ?[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_kakutou_09

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Oh... Um, what I meant was: sorry,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_fairy_08

entries.text: Ah, Lady Eri in a menacing mood... What a vision\nof unusual rarity![VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_doku_07

entries.text: Hey, don’t worry about Ortega—he just doesn’t\nwant you to see him flounderin’.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_aku_07

entries.text: Hey guys? We seem to have lost Mellie...\nWhere’d she go?[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_kakutou_10

entries.text:
Lady Mela declared her wish to stretch her legs
minutes afore your arrival.\c
She departed rather suddenly and has not
return’d since.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_doku_08

entries.text: Well, we all know Mela. She just wandered off\n’cause she doesn’t feel like studying.[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_fairy_09

entries.text: I hate to say it, but I guess that’s probably true...[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_kakutou_11

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Sorry about this, [VAR 0x0100(0000)], but
you
think
you
could
go
find Mela for us?\c
She’ll be somewhere in the academy for sure![VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_aku_08

entries.text: We’ll stay on standby here and get everythin’\nprepped for our killer study sesh.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_aku_09

entries.text: Sorry to keep relying on you like this. I hope you\nfind Mellie without much trouble![VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_kakutou_12

entries.text: Now, what music is best for hittin’ the books...?\c\nRyme’s beats slap, but I guess they’re kinda\noverkill for studyin’...[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_aku_10

entries.text: Mellie’s been pouring so much into her studies\nrecently... Maybe she just needed some exercise?[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_kakutou_13

entries.text:
If you signed yourself up to tutor us, you must be
pretty confident in your book smarts, huh?\c
Tch. Why does a jerk like you get all the talent?
You. Are. The. WORST.[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_fairy_10

entries.text: Verily, scholarship is a labyrinth. Thy guidance\nand encouragement will be most welcome.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_doku_09
